how: We read the website of every Minneapolis wedding videographer listed on Lazo (59 listings, 52 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photographers with no film work, DJ companies that add video, a site that returned only an error page, and a national multi-service chain. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edits arrive, and are raw files included?
For a winter wedding, how do you handle a dark 4:30 ceremony exit and indoor-only coverage?

picks.name: A.B. Rich Films
picks.blurb: Amberleigh and Brad Rich are a Centerville husband-and-wife team: Brad films, she runs the business. Collections range from $3,290 to $6,950, up to 12 hours on the day plus rehearsal dinner and welcome party coverage, all in 4K, and they say audio is the single most important thing they capture.

picks.name: Olsen Media
picks.blurb: Eric Olsen has grown Olsen Media in Lakeville for 10 years alongside lead videographer Justin DeZurik. The site states couples spend on average $4,700 with Eric or $4,550 with Justin, the most popular package is 9 hours with a 9-minute montage plus full ceremony and toasts films, and the highlight reel arrives within a week.

picks.name: Bright House Weddings
picks.blurb: Bright House in St. Louis Park works with a network of professional filmmakers to shoot, then edits everything in-house, a model it says keeps prices down without cutting quality. Build-your-own packages, calm documentary coverage, and films meant to feel timeless rather than trendy.

picks.name: Capture the Moments Productions
picks.blurb: Capture the Moments in Cottage Grove prints its pricing: it currently starts at $2800 and there is a $1,900 winter special from November to March. Coverage runs from 30 minutes before the dress goes on to 30 minutes after the first dance, and the wedding trailer is released the Tuesday after your wedding.

picks.name: Chapel Video Production
picks.blurb: Tate learned video as the camera guy at a Minnesota summer camp starting in 2010 and filmed his first wedding there in 2013. Chapel Video Production is his Minneapolis one-person operation for genuine, candid wedding videos, with promotional work for churches and camps on the side.

picks.name: Pendolium Films
picks.blurb: Dmitriy and Emily Kuzmich are the husband-and-wife filmmakers behind Pendolium Films in Eagan. Their approach is calm and documentary-driven, no staging or interrupting the day, with a cinematic look in the edit; the studio also does corporate and real estate video.

picks.name: MMRY Film Co.
picks.blurb: Memory Film Co. is Tristan Sagastume's Minneapolis studio for luxury wedding films that capture the energy and aesthetic of the day. He brings over a decade of videography experience and says his own wedding going by in a flash is part of why he does this.

picks.name: Hard Copy Film Co.
picks.blurb: Two best friends who spent a decade filming action sports around the world settled in Minneapolis and formed Hard Copy Film Co. Cinematic wedding videography is one specialty alongside corporate work, they are fully licensed and insured drone pilots, and pricing is by inquiry.

picks.name: Eyetography
picks.blurb: Aly shoots video and Kuba shoots photo; they met in college and run Eyetography out of Minneapolis as a combined photo and video team. Every package includes an engagement session because they insist on shooting together before the wedding day.

picks.name: Wild Trail Studio
picks.blurb: Wild Trail Studio in Ham Lake documents weddings with a calm approach inspired by Minnesota's lakes and seasons. Video is an optional add-on to photography coverage: a photography-first, cinematic 3-to-4-minute highlight film that preserves the feeling of the day.

picks.name: Studio Veil
picks.blurb: Studio Veil started in 2005 when two friends decided to offer several wedding services from one local company, and says it handled 290 events last year. A Brooklyn Park team for photography, videography, DJ and photo booth, booked together or separately.

picks.name: Voyageur Motion Pictures - Wedding Videographer
picks.blurb: Voyageur Motion Pictures is a St. Paul luxury wedding videography brand making emotionally resonant films for couples in Minneapolis and worldwide, with drone work. The full site is still coming, and it is accepting limited inquiries for 2026 and 2027.
